reviews.text: This shampoo creates an impressively rich, luxurious lather that feels incredibly soft and soothing on both the hair and scalp. It provides excellent slip for my curls while helping maintain moisture, so my hair never feels dry, stripped, or squeaky after washing. What really stands out to me is how much it has helped restore my hair after using other American shampoos that left it feeling dry, stripped, and damaged. My hair feels softer, healthier, and more moisturized, and I’ve also noticed a significant reduction in frizz. Other people have even commented that my hair feels noticeably softer, which really speaks to the difference I’ve experienced. It honestly makes wash day feel like a calming, spa-like experience. The results have been especially noticeable in the overall softness and condition of my hair. There are a couple of drawbacks, though. The fragrance is quite potent and has a strong aromatherapy quality that may not appeal to everyone. Personally, I can understand why some people love it—the invigorating scent really opens up your nasal passages and leaves you feeling refreshed and energized. The pump cap is another issue. The seal is extremely tight, and instead of coming off gently, it can pop off unexpectedly. Unfortunately, that happened with my bottle. Overall, despite those minor issues, I’m really impressed with the results. This shampoo has helped bring my hair back from that dry, stripped feeling I experienced with other shampoos. My curls feel softer, more moisturized, healthier, and less frizzy. If you enjoy a strong, invigorating fragrance and want a shampoo that truly improves the feel of your hair, this one is definitely worth considering.
reviews.zh:
呢款洗頭水起泡豐富、奢華，摸起嚟好軟滑，對頭髮同頭皮都好舒緩。佢對我嘅捲髮滑順度好好，同時又幫手保持水分，所以洗完頭髮都唔會覺得乾、扯或者發出吱吱聲（squeaky）。最突出嘅係，佢幫我修復咗用其他美國洗頭水之後變得乾身、扯、受損嘅頭髮。我嘅頭髮感覺更軟、更健康、更滋潤，而且我留意到毛躁明顯減少咗。其他人甚至講過我嘅頭髮摸落明顯軟咗，呢點真係反映出我感受到嘅分別。用呢款洗頭嘅時候，真係令洗頭變成一種平靜、似 spa 咁嘅體驗。特別係頭髮整體嘅柔軟度同狀態，效果好明顯。

不過都有幾個缺點。香味好濃，有好強嘅芳香療法感覺，可能唔係人人都鍾意。我可以理解有啲人為咩好鍾意——醒神嘅香味真係令鼻腔暢通，令人覺得清新、有精神。泵頭蓋係另一個問題。密封好緊，而且唔係好易拆，有時會突然彈開。我嘅瓶就發生咗呢件事。

總括嚟講，儘管有啲小問題，我真係好欣賞效果。呢款洗頭水幫我將頭髮從之前用其他洗頭水後嗰種乾身、扯嘅狀態救返。我嘅捲髮感覺更軟、更滋潤、更健康，亦少咗毛躁。如果你鍾意強烈、醒神嘅香味，同時想要一款真係改善到頭髮手感嘅洗頭水，呢款絕對值得考慮。

reviews.text: This shampoos smells really nice, leave my hair silky soft, but in terms of helping hair fall I’m not too sure if it does anything at all havent notice any difference since using it and leaves my hair a little flat but not greasy flat.
reviews.zh: 呢款洗頭水味道好好聞，令頭髮絲滑柔軟。不過講到防脫髮，我唔太肯定佢有冇任何效果，用咗都冇覺得有分別，而且令頭髮有少少扁塌，但係唔係油扁。

reviews.text: lo adoro, il mio stampo preferito insieme a quello O2. migliore combo in assoluto. ho comprato anche il trattamento, insieme sono meravigliosi. provate anche il trattamento peptide cute capelli di Some by Mi, questi 4 sono i miei prodotti preferiti per i capelli in doccia, fuori usate lador siero blu miracle e la pitta. ho capelli fini e mossi tendenti al liscio e questi prodotti sono meravigliosi.
reviews.zh: 我好愛，呢個係我最鍾意嘅款式，同 O2 款式一樣。最強組合。我都買咗護髮療程，兩樣一齊用，好正。都試吓 Some by Mi 嘅 peptide 頭皮護理，呢四樣係我沖涼時用嘅最愛產品，出面就用 lador 嘅藍色奇蹟精華同 pitta。我頭髮幼、有少少波浪，傾向順滑，呢啲產品都好好。

reviews.text: I'm updating my review and even though I looked forward to this shampoo as I heard good things, it made my scap painful after using it. Which is strange because my scalp don't get irritated by other more "chemical" shampoos. I will wait a bit if maybe it's due to something else and see if it's this shampoo or not.
reviews.zh: 我更新咗我嘅評論。雖然我好期待呢款洗頭水，聽聞好多好評，但係用完之後令我頭皮痛。好奇怪，因為我嘅頭皮用其他更「化學」嘅洗頭水都冇事。我會等吓睇吓係咪因為其他原因，同埋係唔係呢款洗頭水嘅問題。

reviews.zh: 呢款洗頭水好好！(˶ˊᵕˋ˵) ♡ 佢令頭髮感覺超清潔，又唔會令頭髮乾燥。質地輕盈，香味清新但唔會太濃 ✿ 我嘅頭皮感覺平衡，每次洗完頭髮都變得柔軟、有光澤！(๑˃ᴗ˂)ﻭ 適合油性或幼身頭髮，超級推薦！💫

reviews.text: I got this after falling in love with their hair treatment. I wanted to see the maximum effect of this line since I was loving the results from the hair treatment. Since I just started using the shampoo I haven’t noticed a difference in my scalp, but my hair did feel lighter? I have very thick hair and currently it’s very long, so it’s been difficult to maintain especially when my scalp gets oily, so I can only assume it did a really good job cleansing the oil out so my hair feels light again. As someone who is sensitive to scents (I get migraines), I didn’t mind the scent or the way it lingers on the hair strands afterwards. It’s slightly fruity, floral, clean, and crisp.
reviews.zh: 我係因為愛上咗佢哋嘅護髮療程先買呢款。我想睇下呢個系列嘅最大效果，因為我好鍾意護髮療程嘅效果。我啱啱開始用洗頭水，未見到頭皮有咩分別，但係我嘅頭髮感覺輕咗？我嘅頭髮好厚，而家又好長，所以好難打理，特別係頭皮容易出油嗰陣。我估佢一定好好噉清走咗頭髮嘅油脂，所以頭髮又輕返。我對氣味好敏感（我會偏頭痛），但我唔介意香味，亦唔介意佢喺頭髮上留低嘅味道。佢有少少果香、花香、清新而爽朗。
